title: Native Generation Policy
description: Defines rules for the nativeGenerated marker. Specifies what qualifies as natively generated, what must be marked reconstructed, and prohibits claiming reconstructed artifacts as native.

nativeGeneratedDefinition.description: An artifact is nativeGenerated:true if and only if it was created during its declared phase by a duly spawned worker agent with fork_context:true and without retroactive reconstruction from post-hoc evidence.

requiredConditions.description: The artifact's generatedAt timestamp falls within the active window of its declared phase.
requiredConditions.verification: Cross-check generatedAt against phase timeline in AGENT_PROGRESS.jsonl.

requiredConditions.description: The worker contract must have fork_context:true, confirming the agent was spawned with forked context, not as a retroactive summary reconstruction.
The artifact must not have reconstructedFrom field set. If reconstructedFrom is present, nativeGenerated must be false regardless of other conditions.
requiredConditions.verification: Check for presence of reconstructedFrom in artifact metadata.

requiredConditions.description: The artifact must be within the worker's owned directories per its contract scope.
requiredConditions.verification: Cross-check file path against worker contract scope.ownedDirectories.

requiredConditions.description: A worker completion transcript must exist that covers the time window when the artifact was created.
requiredConditions.verification: Check for transcript with timestamps bracketing generatedAt.

reconstructedDefinition.description: An artifact is reconstructed if it was created after its declared phase ended, from post-hoc evidence rather than active worker execution.
markers: reconstructedFrom field is present and non-null.
generatedAt is after phase close timestamp.
fork_context is false or missing in worker contract.
restrictions: Reconstructed artifacts must declare reconstructedFrom with reference to source evidence.
Reconstructed artifacts cannot serve as primary evidence for PASS verdicts unless corroborated by native artifacts.
Reconstructed artifacts must carry a reconstruction warning in their description.

prohibitions.description: An artifact with reconstructedFrom set or retroactive:true MUST NOT have nativeGenerated:true.
prohibitions.verifierCheck: If reconstructedFrom is non-null, assert nativeGenerated === false.

prohibitions.description: If fork_context is false or missing, nativeGenerated must be false.
prohibitions.verifierCheck: If forkContext is falsy, assert nativeGenerated === false.

prohibitions.description: If generatedAt is after the phase close timestamp, nativeGenerated must be false.
If no worker transcript exists bracketing the generatedAt time, nativeGenerated should be considered suspect.
prohibitions.verifierCheck: Verify transcript coverage window includes generatedAt.

retroactiveContracts.description: Worker contracts generated retroactively for completed phases.
rules: Must have reconstructedFrom referencing the source evidence used to reconstruct the contract.
Retroactive contracts cannot be used to satisfy dependency declarations for native phases.
